subject.title: feat: generic session discussion seam with Control UI panel

question: Should the public session-discussion provider contract expose an agent-qualified session identity and be lifecycle-owned by the plugin loader before this generic SDK/gateway seam is accepted?
rationale: The implementation can mechanically carry an agent identity and add transaction hooks, but maintainers must choose the permanent public provider identity and lifecycle contract before shipping a new SDK entrypoint and protocol methods.

options.title: Define the durable generic contract
options.body: Require an agent-qualified session identity and plugin-transaction restore/clear semantics, then update the SDK, protocol, UI callers, and regression tests before merge.

options.title: Keep this provider private for now
options.body: Land the concrete integration only behind its owning plugin until maintainers settle the reusable SDK and gateway contract.

recommendation.title: Define the durable generic contract
recommendation.body: Require an agent-qualified session identity and plugin-transaction restore/clear semantics, then update the SDK, protocol, UI callers, and regression tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the proposed cross-surface API and its follow-up changes, making them the clearest available routing candidate for the contract decision.
